intro.text: A dead man whose shade, people say, protects Silence's waystop from its enemies, a story Silence may have started herself.
Silence Montane's late partner and the father of William Ann Montane.

items.text: Silence's grandmother knew him, perhaps because he worked at her waystop, and thought him a fool; she believed Silence better off after his death. Silence became pregnant by him shortly before he died.
Since his death his shade is said to protect Silence's waystop, a tale Silence may have spread herself.
